entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child with neck-length short brown hair, facing away from the camera, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls, seated on Vehicle A.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low three-wheeled vehicle ridden by Person A, with a blue high backrest, part of a red frame, and two wide black rear wheels visible at the rear.

entities.name: carpet
entities.identification: The carpet covering the corridor floor, with a repeating geometric pattern in orange, dark brown, and red.

entities.name: corridor wall
entities.identification: The light beige walls on both sides of the corridor, with vertical corners and dark baseboards.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The groups of dark brown doors arranged along both sides of the corridor, with narrow dark doorframes; some door handles are brass-colored.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored ceiling above the corridor, with transverse beam surfaces and edge molding.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The group of ceiling lights arranged along the depth of the corridor, with white round shades and bright undersides.

entities.name: interior framed picture
entities.identification: The framed picture on the left corridor wall, with a narrow dark frame and a light-colored vertically elongated rectangular picture area.
